Hence no three collinear (D=0 absent) and no unimodular/area-0.5 triple (D=1 absent); D(S*)=2, A=1.0 proved by exhaustive integer enumeration, no floats, deterministic. Secondary claim H(S*)=6 verified independently: witness W={(0,1),(0,3),(1,7),(2,3),(3,6),(3,9)} has monotone-chain hull size 6 (strictly convex) and zero S*-points strictly inside conv(W) under exact sign-of-det predicates; exhaustive search over C(20,7)=77520 7-subsets finds zero empty-convex 7-sets (0.3s), and alternative angular-sort convexity test over C(20,8) finds zero empty-convex 8-sets, so by monotonicity (any empty convex k>7 contains an empty convex 7-subset, since subsets of strictly convex position sets are strictly convex and conv(subset) subset conv(parent)) H<=6, hence H=6. This closes the dependence on unprovided scratch/hcalc.py. Search-method description is honest stochastic existence proof with explicit disclaimers (no optimality, gaps are best-found not impossibility, D>=3 open); no proof/experiment conflation. One non-material presentation imprecision noted: DRAFT section 3 tail histogram beyond det=10 lists 11:15, 12:53(? from seed-6 set), max 109-scale, whereas exact full histogram is 11:8, 12:26, max 100 (full table verified by auditor). originality.rationale: Claim is explicit 20-point 12x12 lattice set with doubled-area minimum >=2, i.e. simultaneously zero collinear and zero area-0.5 triples. Nearest priors compared substantively: (1) Continuous Heilbronn optima (Friedman table to n~35, proved only to n=9; e.g. n=20 best normalized A~0.0129) allow real coordinates and give only scaled upper-bound analogy; lattice quantization to 0.5*Z with exact integer-determinant audit is a disjoint search space and audit protocol. Normalized S* area 1.0/121=0.00826 does not duplicate continuous records. (2) No-three-in-line (Prellberg 2n collinear-free points for n<=60, so 24 points on 12x12 with D>=1) forbids only det==0; it guarantees D>=1 and says nothing about det==1. Auditor baseline confirms parabola 11-point set has (D=1, n0=0, n1=6) and random 20-sets have n0~10-30, n1~16-34, so D>=2 is not implied by D>=1 existence. Parity-scaling trivialization fails by pigeonhole: any even-x (6 values) or even-even (6x6) subset with 20 points forces a vertical collinear triple (ceil(20/6)>=4 on one x), so mixed parities as in S* are required; the 0.5->1.0 step forbidding all lattice-basis triples is qualitative, not relabeling. (3) Asymptotic Heilbronn bounds (Cohen-Pohoata-Zakharov n^{-8/7-1/2000} upper bound improving Komlos-Pintz-Szemeredi, Omega(log n/n^2) lower bounds) are large-n continuous statements providing no explicit small-grid integer configuration or verification protocol. (4) Empty-convex-hole literature (empty pentagons/hexagons, random-set Theta(log n/log log n) largest hole) counts holes in arbitrary position, not max-min area nor grid-restricted H(S); H=6 here is secondary grid-restricted metric, distinct. Topic prior scan zero-hit checks (arXiv lattice+Heilbronn+triangle, Heilbronn+prime+grid; OpenAlex grid-Heilbronn returning only irrelevant carbon-concrete hits) are consistent with auditor baseline experiments showing ~5% SA hit rate (5/96 seeds) versus stall of naive hill-climbing at (0,8): frontier was open and required pure-(n0,n1) objective insight (c2/c3 penalties trap at (0,1)). No prior SCOPE success (001 4-uniform families, 003 J2-free rank, 002 spider mixing) or failure (003 Szemeredi-Trotter 4x4 incidence, 004 Z_197 bases, 002 dicyclic gaps, 001 Polya-Vinogradov) states, covers, or implies this lattice Heilbronn threshold. Hence configurational novelty is substantive, not timestamp/search-failure alone.

Not textbook: no textbook gives maximal lattice-min-area tables for 12x12 n=20; small-det/record tables are absent. Not parameter substitution: m=11 vs 12 relabeling would preserve D>=1 class, whereas D>=2 eliminates all unimodular pairs (Pick quantization structural step connecting discrete geometry, additive combinatorics, exact verification); impossibility of parity-restricted scaling shown above proves parameters are not interchangeable. Not tiny unmotivated gain: factor-2 doubling of minimal area (0.5->1.0) with 34 det-2 triples as quantified distance to D>=3, plus 5 independent D>=2 sets and new D>=2 configs for (10,12),(10,16),(12,12),(12,16),(12,18) in fallback sweeps, is a motivated quantized jump with explicit gap analysis, not a 1% tweak. Not unexplained enumeration: coordinates plus <1s independent exact verifier, full exact histogram (1140 triples), empty-convex certificate with witness, methodological finding (pure (n0,n1) lexicographic objective finds D>=2 in 3/32 seeds at ~0.5s each where c2/c3-penalized ILS traps at (0,1)), and benchmark/gap table with reuse instructions provide explanation and reuse beyond raw list. Genre-appropriate contribution for exact-combinatorial discrete geometry where explicit checkable configurations are the standard record form; third party can rerun deterministically on laptop. Secondary H=6 and D>=3 openness (min c2=34) give forward research hooks.
